description: AMF-approved portfolio management company (real estate), created 2011, wholly owned subsidiary of Groupe Cyrus (France's largest independent wealth-management/CGPI group). Covers the full real-estate value chain: real-estate investment funds, club deals, SCPI allocation advisory, and residential lot investments across office, hospitality, logistics and residential. ~30 staff. Leadership: Jose Zaraya (Group Cyrus Directeur General since 2013, President of Eternam since 2015), with Jonathan Donio and Frederic Maxwell recently promoted to President and Directeur General Delegue of Eternam respectively.

fit.reasoning: Fit 50/60: priority segment fund manager (20) + priority market France (15) + third-party client money via funds/club deals/SCPI advisory serving Cyrus's high-net-worth and institutional client base (10) + AMF-regulated (5); no multi-asset credit (0), real-estate-only specialist. Trigger 12/25: a recent leadership promotion (Jonathan Donio to President, Frederic Maxwell to Directeur General Delegue) is a genuine senior change, scored at the lower end of the new-hire band since it reads as an internal promotion rather than an external senior-ops/compliance hire, and the exact date is not confirmed. Access 8/15: named leadership (Jose Zaraya, Jonathan Donio, Frederic Maxwell) identified via press, not yet confirmed reachable. Total 70, moderated to 60: part of the Cyrus Herez group (see cyrus-herez.yaml) - coordinate any pursuit across Amplegest/Eternam/Cyrus Herez rather than treating as three unrelated firms, and real-estate-only specialists often already run dedicated REIM/SCPI tooling.
